title: The Time Flowing on the Canal
subtitle: A documentary project on the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal created by the Social Narrative Studio of the China Academy of Art

mainContent.content: A **documentary IED** project from the **Social Narrative Studio (CAA)** on the **Beijing–Hangzhou Grand Canal**: treating the waterway as **living time**—commerce, ecology, memory, and migration folded into **one longitudinal story**.

- **Time as current**: slow civic change vs. fast urban renewal.
- **Voices along the bank**: social narrative as **collage**, not a single hero arc.
- **Place truth**: images anchor claims; text explains **why this stretch matters now**.
